title: Draft renewal pitch for key customer
text: Draft a renewal pitch for [customer name] based on this renewal history and value data: [paste data]. Include key ROI proof points and renewal recommendation. Output as a short pitch and optional follow-up email.
problem: Analisis atau keputusan perniagaan tentang “Draft renewal pitch for key customer” memerlukan data dan pembuktian.
output: Pelan perniagaan, analisis, jadual atau cadangan jualan (hasil sasaran, belum diuji)
hook: Keputusan perniagaan penting, tetapi input atau analisis belum mencukupi? Fokus: Draft renewal pitch for key customer.
solution: Tugasan: Draft renewal pitch for key customer. Masukkan angka, pasaran dan tempoh yang diketahui; nyatakan andaian dan sahkan pengiraan sebelum membuat keputusan.
cta: Masukkan data sebenar dan sahkan angka, andaian serta risiko sebelum membuat keputusan.
